items.title: Furnished room 200m from UNSW, all bills included
items.household: Not stated. Ad is aimed at UNSW students and staff. No gender preference, no smoking. Shared bathroom and kitchen. Couples allowed for +$80/wk only if all flatmates approve. Coin laundry $4 a load.
inspection_questions: The ad says available now: can the room be held for a start in early January 2027, and is any holding fee involved?
How many people live in the house now, and are they students or workers?
Is the 1-week bond lodged with NSW Rental Bonds Online, and what agreement do I sign?
Is there a fair-use cap on the included electricity, gas, water and internet?
How many people share the bathroom and kitchen?
items.enquiry_draft: Hi, I'm [your name], a UNSW postgraduate student, and I'm interested in your room 200m from UNSW. I'm looking to move in early January 2027: could the room be available then? Could you confirm that all bills and internet stay included, and whether there is any usage cap? I'd also like to know the lease length you prefer after the 3-month minimum, and when I could inspect. Thank you.
items.notes: Best all-round fit: all 4 bills included, 1-week bond, closest to campus. Ad says available now (listing date 27 Sep 2026); ask about a January start. No street address in the ad; about 10 photos. Distance from the ad's '200m from UNSW' ⚠️ estimate.

items.title: Single rooms in Randwick/Coogee flats, all bills included (from $250)
items.lease: 3 months minimum (owner prefers 2 years or more)
items.household: Building of 4 flats with 3 bedrooms each, aimed at international students. No gender preference. Tenants must be very clean and very quiet; no parties; no smoking. Blankets, sheets, pillow and fan provided; laundry free.
inspection_questions: Which single rooms are free from early January 2027, and which is $250 versus $350?
What is the street address, and how long is the walk or bus to UNSW?
How much bond is asked, and is it lodged with NSW Rental Bonds Online?
How many people share each flat's bathroom and kitchen?
Is a 6 to 12 month stay acceptable given the preference for 2+ years?
items.enquiry_draft: Hi, I'm [your name], a UNSW postgraduate student, and I'm interested in a single room in your Randwick/Coogee flats. I'd like to move in early January 2027 and stay at least 6 to 12 months. Could you tell me which rooms will be free then and their weekly price? Could you also confirm that electricity, gas, water and internet are all included, and how much bond you ask? I'd be glad to inspect at a time that suits you.
items.notes: All 4 bills included. Rent is a range: single rooms $250 to $350/wk, large double $400/wk ($200 per person if shared); $250 used here as the from-price. Exact location not given; distance and bus time ⚠️ estimate (Randwick suburb centre).

items.title: Furnished single room by Coogee Beach, all utilities and Wi-Fi included
